Report mandates (6 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the mayor and the council a report providing an explanation for any violations which were not included in the list.
    report · deadline 2018-07-18 · one-time · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit an annual report on the alternative-fuel street-sweeping pilot project and related testing, analyses, and assessments.
    report · deadline: Not later than January 1, 2007, and not later than January 1 of each year thereafter · annual · Administrative Code § 24-163.2(d)(2) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit the results and an analysis of each follow-up study to the council and the mayor.
    report · deadline: within 60 days of their completion · one-time · Administrative Code § 16-316.1(a) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit the results and an analysis of each detailed, comprehensive citywide multi-season study to the council and the mayor.
    report · deadline: within 60 days of such study’s completion · one-time · Administrative Code § 16-316.1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide the Mayor and Speaker of the Council with a report on the pilot program upon its conclusion.
    report · deadline: upon its conclusion · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Include in the report an evaluation of whether and where the power washing pilot program is suitable for expansion, guidelines for how many miles of sidewalk within commercial corridors should be power washed per year, and an evaluation of the impact that pedestrian volume and susceptibility to heat island effects has on feasibility and desirability of using power washing machines to clean sidewalk surfaces in such locations.
    report · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗

Rulemaking mandates

  • ◆Mandate · By rule, create a list of violations for which civil penalties may be waived if the individual receiving such violation participates in a penalty mitigation program.
    rulemaking · deadline 2018-07-18 · one-time · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Promulgate rules detailing procedures for claiming publicly accessible collection bins removed by the department.
    rulemaking · one-time · Administrative Code § 10-169(b)(6) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Regulate the conduct of businesses authorized to collect commercial waste in commercial waste zones and establish and enforce specified standards and requirements.
    rulemaking · ongoing · New York City Charter § 753(e)(2) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Promulgate rules requiring generators of waste collected by licensed businesses to source separate designated materials as necessary to minimize contamination and maximize marketability, subject to the statutory economic-market limitation.
    rulemaking · one-time · Administrative Code § 16-306(b)(1) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Adopt and implement rules necessary to effectuate the official waste container subdivision, including container allocation standards.
    rulemaking · ongoing · § 1, subdivision j(3) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Adopt and implement rules necessary to effectuate the official waste container reimbursement program.
    rulemaking · ongoing · § 2 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The commissioner may not allow a rule prohibiting a supplemental sanitation service provider from placing refuse or recycling next to or against a public litter basket, or at another specified location, to take effect before August 1, 2028.
    rulemaking · deadline: prior to August 1, 2028 · one-time · § 1, subdivision e, paragraph 3(a) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The commissioner may not allow a rule requiring materials placed out for collection by the department to be in rigid receptacles with tight-fitting lids to take effect before August 1, 2028.
